stories.title: Why the current tech backlash feels different
stories.simple_summary: People are becoming more critical of big tech companies and their products. This pushback feels different from previous complaints.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about big trends in society — nothing specific you need to act on right now.

stories.title: Seattle officials question FD over ambulance contractor, AI-assisted 911 triage
stories.simple_summary: Seattle officials are questioning whether an ambulance company should use AI to help decide which 911 calls are most urgent.
stories.why_it_matters: If you live in Seattle and call 911, the ambulance system might use AI to prioritize calls — this could affect how quickly help arrives.

stories.title: Mathematicians want proof OpenAI didn’t use their work
stories.simple_summary: Mathematicians say OpenAI (the company behind ChatGPT) may have used their unpublished research without permission to train its AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters mostly to researchers and investors — it's about whether the AI company acted fairly in getting its data.

stories.title: Japan’s AI satellites and other space ambitions ‘a serious threat’, China warns
stories.simple_summary: China is warning that Japan's plan to use AI in satellites could be dangerous.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about international politics and military concerns — nothing that affects your daily life.

stories.title: For years they warned AI could kill all humans. Now people are listening.
stories.simple_summary: Researchers who have warned for years that advanced AI could become dangerous are finally getting more attention and people taking them seriously.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about long-term concerns over AI safety — important for society, but no immediate action you need to take.

stories.title: Commission Urges UK to Overhaul Regulation of AI Medicine
stories.simple_summary: A UK government group says the rules for AI used in medicine need to be stricter and updated.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're in the UK and use medical services, stronger rules for medical AI could make those tools safer for you.

stories.title: ‘For 2 years, we’ve held our tongues’: Democrats clap back at 1 of Silicon Valley’s biggest donors
stories.simple_summary: Democrats are publicly criticizing one of Silicon Valley's major donors over disagreements.
stories.why_it_matters: This is politics and insider conflicts — nothing directly affecting your business or daily life.

stories.title: AI research startup Listen Labs scrubbed a $1.5B funding round for Salesforce talks
stories.simple_summary: A startup called Listen Labs turned down a $1.5 billion investment offer to have talks with Salesforce instead.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech industry watchers — not something that affects you.

stories.title: Can humans stay in control of AI?
stories.simple_summary: Experts are asking whether humans can stay in charge as AI systems become more powerful.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a big philosophical question for society — important to think about, but not an immediate practical concern for your business.

stories.title: OpenAI adds a prominent AI doomer to its board of directors
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI hired a researcher named Paul Christiano who has worried publicly about AI risks and safety.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors in AI companies — it signals OpenAI cares about safety concerns.

stories.title: Massachusetts hits data centers with new clean power rules
stories.simple_summary: Massachusetts passed new rules requiring data centers (the giant computer buildings that power AI and websites) to use cleaner energy.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have a business in Massachusetts, this makes energy rules stricter for large tech operations — probably doesn't affect you unless you run a data center.

stories.title: Suno releases its first AI music model made with record industry help
stories.simple_summary: An AI music company called Suno made a new version of its music-making tool, this time with permission and help from record labels.
stories.why_it_matters: If you make music or need background music for your business, you might soon have a legal AI tool for that instead of worrying about copying someone's work.
